items.t: Relief for defaulters fails to stem bad loans
items.d: Bad loans in the country’s banking sector continue to rise despite years of generous forbearance measures by the central bank, including loan restructuring, rescheduling, interest waivers and one-time exit facilities.

items.t: Everest replaces Saif Powertec as interim CCT operator
items.d: Local logistics company Everest Port Services Ltd has won a six-month contract to operate Chittagong Container Terminal (CCT) at Chattogram port, replacing local operator Saif Powertec Ltd.

items.t: BTRC asks Robi to explain use of Cirkle brand
items.d: The Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Commission (BTRC) has issued a show-cause notice to Robi Axiata PLC, asking why the telecom operator should not be directed to stop using the brand name “Cirkle”.

items.t: Ctg holds huge potential for German investors
items.d: Chattogram’s strategic location beside the country’s premier seaport and its growing industrial base offer huge potential to attract German investors, German Ambassador to Bangladesh Rüdiger Lotz has said.

items.t: Oil’s Iran war recovery masks a stubborn diesel shortage
items.d: Nine months into the biggest energy shock in modern history, the oil market’s recovery is surprisingly swift, but plentiful crude supplies are masking a stubborn diesel shortage that could yet upend fuel markets.

items.t: Vietnam builds commodity exchange to boost farm produce
items.d: In a bid to move from a major agricultural producer to a global price-setter, Vietnam is laying the groundwork for a domestic commodity derivatives market.

items.t: Working in the age of AI
items.d: Last year, I was sitting in the waiting area of a GP clinic in Singapore, and my serial number was 11. As patients went into the consulting room and quickly came out, I noticed a pattern.

items.t: BRAC Bank, Heidelberg Materials partner to strengthen distributor financing
items.d: BRAC Bank PLC has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Heidelberg Materials Bangladesh PLC, one of the country’s largest cement manufacturers, to provide distributor-financing facilities to the company’s distribution network.

items.t: Bangladesh showcases tea, food products at Karachi expo
items.d: Bangladesh is showcasing its tea, processed food and agricultural products at the fourth International Food and Agriculture Exhibition (FoodAg 2026) in Karachi, Pakistan, seeking to tap export opportunities and forge new business links with international buyers.

items.t: Uttara Motors rolls out new-generation Suzuki Dzire
items.d: Uttara Motors Limited, the distributor of Suzuki passenger vehicles in Bangladesh, has launched the all-new Suzuki Dzire, featuring sophisticated styling, modern technology, enhanced comfort and everyday practicality.
